senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; denom. of פְּנִים)inner, interior, innermost, central.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 65b:6">Erub. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>ישראל ונכרי בפ׳ וכ׳</he> if an Israelite and a gentile live in the inner court, and an Israelite in the outer court.

<cite ref="Eruvin 65b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ במקומו מהו</he> dare the resident of the inner court move things within its precincts? Tanḥ. Naso 5 <he>פתח את הפ׳ וכ׳</he> he opened the central door and went to the outer room.
<cite ref="Zevachim 51a">Zeb. 51ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מזבה הפ׳</he> the inner altar (in the Holy); a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21:9">Gen. R. s. 21</cite> (ref. to <he>פלמוני</he>, <cite ref="Daniel 8:13">Dan. VIII, 13</cite>) <he>תרגם עקילס לפ׳ … לפנים ממלאכי וכ׳</he> Aquila translated it ‘to him who was inside’, which means Adam whose partitioned seat was in front of the ministering angels (v. <cite ref="Q01199"><he>פְּנִים</he></cite>); Yalk. Dan. 1066.—Pl. <he>פְּנִימִיִּים</he>; f. <he>פְּנִימִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 52b:6">Zeb. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>דמים הפ׳</he> blood to be sprinkled in the Holy; <he>שיריים הפ׳</he> the remnants of blood sprinkled in the Holy.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:4">Tam. I, 4</cite>; Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ, v. <cite ref="A01696"><he>אָכַל</he></cite>; a. fr.
